title: Distributed GraphLab: A Framework for Machine Learning and Data Mining in the Cloud
authors: Yucheng Low, Joseph Gonzalez, Aapo Kyrola, Danny Bickson, Carlos Guestrin, Joseph M. Hellerstein
description: Extends the GraphLab shared-memory abstraction to distributed clusters using graph-based data partitioning, pipelined locking, and asynchronous fault-tolerant snapshotting, outperforming Hadoop by 20–60x on large-scale machine learning tasks.
